def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    p9=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==9]
    # Maroon markers lie on the edge opposite the one toward which zero runs move.
    if max(c for r,c in p9)>=w-2: axis, target=1,0
    elif min(c for r,c in p9)<=1: axis,target=1,1
    elif max(r for r,c in p9)>=h-2: axis,target=0,0
    else: axis,target=0,1
    out=[[7]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Preserve maroon cells, then reflect/reposition every maximal zero run.
    for r,c in p9: out[r][c]=9
    if axis==1:
      for r in range(h):
        c=0
        while c<w:
          if g[r][c]!=0: c+=1; continue
          s=c
          while c<w and g[r][c]==0: c+=1
          n=c-s
          if target==0:
            start=0 if c==w else s # opposite-edge runs keep length; target-edge runs shrink below
            if s==0: n=1
            start=0
          else:
            if c==w: n=1
            start=w-n
          for k in range(n): out[r][start+k]=0
    else:
      for c in range(w):
        r=0
        while r<h:
          if g[r][c]!=0: r+=1; continue
          s=r
          while r<h and g[r][c]==0: r+=1
          n=r-s
          if target==0:
            if s==0: n=1
            start=0
          else:
            if r==h: n=1
            start=h-n
          for k in range(n): out[start+k][c]=0
    return out
